derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 f8949.pdf (IRS fillable form): for every entry, the widget /Rect of the field (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form; a field is assigned to the line whose printed label sits on the same row (widget y-center within ~6pt of the label row) and, for table columns, whose x-band matches the printed column. Checkbox on-states were read from each widget's /AP /N appearance keys with pypdf. The TY2025 fillable has ELEVEN transaction rows per part (Row1..Row11, 8 fields each: f1_03..f1_90 on page 1, f2_03..f2_90 on page 2), not 14: row widgets step 24pt from y-center 384 (page 1) / 420 (page 2) down to the totals row (f1_91..f1_95 / f2_91..f2_95). Column x-bands verified against the printed header: (a) description 36-172.05, (b) date acquired 172.8-223.2, (c) date sold 223.2-273.6, (d) proceeds 273.6-337.65, (e) cost/basis 338.4-402.45, (f) code 403.2-446.4, (g) adjustment amount 446.4-510.45, (h) gain/(loss) 511.2-576. The totals row carries FIVE fields; the field in the (f) band (f1_93/f2_93) is deliberately NOT mapped: the printed totals instruction totals columns (d), (e), (g) and (h) only, so (d)=_91, (e)=_92, (g)=_94, (h)=_95 by x-band. Box checkboxes are one Btn field per page with six widgets in printed order: page 1 A=/1, B=/2, C=/3, G=/4, H=/5, I=/6 (c1_1[0..5], y descending with the printed list); page 2 D=/1, E=/2, F=/3, J=/4, K=/5, L=/6 (c2_1[0..5]). Only Box A (short-term) and Box D (long-term) are used in v1: every v1 1099-B entry is treated as basis-reported.
